title: Musician's Haven 7 miles to DT Off-Street Parking
description:
Tucked in a quiet neighborhood, our home has welcomed families and musicians alike-some famous, all unforgettable. Play the piano, guitars, or ukulele, and relax in two inviting living areas, a glassed-in front porch perfect for morning coffee or late-night chats, and a sunny back deck that’s just right for unwinding after a long day.

With a full kitchen, comfy beds, and off-street parking, there's space for everyone to feel at home. Come make memories—and maybe a little music—while you're here

The space
Spacious, Fun & Perfect for Groups – 4BR, 3BA Retreat

Welcome to your home away from home! This spacious 2800 sq. ft. mid-century ranch offers room for everyone to spread out and relax, with 4 bedrooms, 3 full baths, and cozy touches throughout.

On the main level, you'll find:

A serene primary suite with a king bed and private ensuite bath

A sunny second bedroom with a queen bed

A versatile third bedroom that doubles as a home office with a twin daybed + trundle—perfect for kids or work-from-home guests

Downstairs, unwind in a massive primary suite with a fireplace, wet bar/kitchenette, and a third full bath—ideal for privacy or extended stays. You’ll also love the media room, complete with a 50" HDTV with Roku, a game table, and another twin daybed with trundle for extra sleeping space.

The fully equipped kitchen includes a rolling island for flexibility and flows out to a comfortably furnished deck with a gas grill. 

The glassed-in front porch is perfect for morning coffee or late-night chats.

Enjoy high-speed internet and Roku TVs throughout the home. (Please note: we don’t offer cable TV.)

For outdoor fun, Seven Oaks Park is just 2 miles away with new pickleball courts, a disc golf course, and plenty of space to play.

Whether you're traveling with family, friends, or a creative crew, our home is designed to make you feel welcome, inspired, and totally at ease.

Guest access
We have a keyless entry and you'll have a door code to allow easy access and no problems getting a key.

Other things to note
We’ve got you covered with fresh linens, towels, dish soap, dishwasher pods, bar soap, and a starter supply of paper goods to get you going.

That includes:
🧻 2 rolls of toilet paper per bathroom
🧼 1 roll of paper towels in the kitchen

You'll also find a small supply of laundry detergent and dryer sheets— enough to wash a load or two of your clothes and toss in a load of towels before checkout. If you plan to do lots of laundry during your stay, feel free to pick up a bit more soap.

Thanks so much—we’re glad to have you!
